items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: This band with Sonny Stitt, Wynton Kelly and myself, Jimmy Cobb, Candido. This was an excellent band--small band.

ctx.x: Calling me from South America, you know. So I--after I quit that band, I didn't want no more of that. That was enough of that, man. My nerves was getting ready--then I went in Dizzy's band--Dizzy Gillespie--which was a fine band. This band was--oh, man, and we didn't record not one note. This band with Sonny Stitt, Wynton Kelly and myself, Jimmy Cobb, Candido. This was an excellent band--small band.
Oh yeah? When was this? What year was that?
